items: rc1c2c5 Get Started with Knack's HOA CTA

proposed_rules.trigger: A large product screenshot area followed immediately by an 'Install Free Template App' CTA button, on download/template-detail pages.
proposed_rules.decision: Model as a single 'template-preview' block combining the screenshot and CTA link in minimal cells.
proposed_rules.rationale: Same recurring component as C37 and C38; rejected modeling as section background image (button sits below, not overlaid) or as two independent blocks.

proposed_rules.trigger: Identical top nav and bottom footer recur on every captured page.
proposed_rules.decision: Model as global header/footer fragments, excluded from the per-page section/block inventory.
proposed_rules.rationale: Recurs identically across all templates; not covered by existing noise rules.

notes: Same download-template shape as C37: title, intro+numbered feature grid, screenshot+install CTA, bg-color feature-detail grid, closing CTA banner.
